target: acceptance 5 — the reopens counter is labelled BUILD CHURN and nothing ASSERTS it measures work re-opened after merge. Negated mentions are fine and in fact wanted: the rendering says outright that it is not a post-merge signal, and a cruder check counted that denial as the very claim it forbids.
cmd: mkdir -p .agentic/observability; printf "%s" '{"observability":{"enabled":true}}' > .agentic/config.json; cp "$FIXTURES/comprehension/events.jsonl" .agentic/observability/events-20260801.jsonl; unset CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR AGENTIC_OBSERVE; o=$("$PLUGIN_ROOT/scripts/observe_metrics.sh" comprehension --format tsv 2>/dev/null); hdr=$(printf "%s" "$o" | grep -v "^#" | head -1); churn=$(printf "%s" "$hdr" | grep -c "build_churn"); hdrbad=$(printf "%s" "$hdr" | grep -ci "after_merge\|post_merge\|reopen"); bad=$(printf "%s" "$o" | grep -i "re-open rate\|reopen rate\|after merge\|post-merge"         | grep -vi "not \|never \|before merge" | wc -l | tr -d " "); denies=$(printf "%s" "$o" | grep -ci "not a post-merge signal"); d=$(grep -i "re-open rate\|post-merge re" "$PLUGIN_ROOT/templates/observability/dashboards.md" 2>/dev/null      | grep -vi "not \|never \|no post-merge" | wc -l | tr -d " "); printf '{"named":%s,"headerClaims":%s,"falseClaims":%s,"denies":%s,"docClaims":%s}' "$churn" "$hdrbad" "$bad" "$denies" "$d"
